headline: Sri Lanka market rates rose after May hike: Central bank
summary: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka raised its policy rate by another 25 basis points to 9 percent to curb rising inflation. Market interest rates have risen steadily since a 100-basis-point hike in May 2026.
why: Policy rate decisions set the cost of borrowing across an economy and influence bond yields, the currency and equity valuations. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka is the country's monetary authority.
why_moved: The central bank raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to curb inflation, and market rates have been adjusting upward since May.
